messages.author: 3be65e68ba76d9f5
messages.subject: Conditional Tab Panels
parts:
Hi, may I suggest to allow conditionally showing/hiding tab panels (similarly to conditionalPanel)?
An option would be to insert a line into the tabsetPanel function:
if(!is.null(divTag$attribs$condition)) liTag$attribs$`data-display-if` <- divTag$attribs$condition
and then e.g.
tabPanel("Table", tableOutput("table"),condition="input.dist=='norm'")
Example here: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/szakacs/test6/
However, in this case the shiny.js should be modified to activate another tab if needed.
Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Conditional Tab Panels
parts:
In the development version of Shiny, there's a function called updateTabsetInput, which will let you control the active tab.

You can see a demo here. If you move the slider at the top, you'll see that it switches tabs.
  http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winstontest/setinput/

Code here:
  https://github.com/wch/testapp/blob/master/setinput/server.R

-Winston
